---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m4p4t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Capacity, TotalCars

ASSUME Capacity \in Nat /\ Capacity >= 1
ASSUME TotalCars \in Nat /\ TotalCars >= 1

VARIABLES
    onLine,      \* cars presently on the conveyor
    parked,      \* cars still waiting in the source lot
    washed,      \* cars that finished and drove off
    backpressure,\* TRUE when the line has signalled it is full
    adminForce   \* privileged supervisor override is engaged

vars == << onLine, parked, washed, backpressure, adminForce >>

Init ==
    /\ onLine = 0
    /\ parked = TotalCars
    /\ washed = 0
    /\ backpressure = FALSE
    /\ adminForce = FALSE

\* An ordinary intake: only when not held back and a free slot exists.
Admit ==
    /\ ~backpressure
    /\ parked > 0
    /\ onLine < Capacity
    /\ onLine' = onLine + 1
    /\ parked' = parked - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << washed, backpressure, adminForce >>

\* The line raises backpressure once it is one slot from full.
Engage ==
    /\ ~backpressure
    /\ onLine >= Capacity - 1
    /\ backpressure' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << onLine, parked, washed, adminForce >>

\* Backpressure clears once the line has drained enough.
Release ==
    /\ backpressure
    /\ onLine < Capacity - 1
    /\ backpressure' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << onLine, parked, washed, adminForce >>

\* A car finishes the wash cycle and leaves.
Finish ==
    /\ onLine > 0
    /\ onLine' = onLine - 1
    /\ washed' = washed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << parked, backpressure, adminForce >>

\* Supervisor toggles the privileged override.
ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ adminForce' = ~adminForce
    /\ UNCHANGED << onLine, parked, washed, backpressure >>

\* Under override the supervisor may push a car past a raised hold,
\* but the physical bay count is still respected.
ForceAdmit ==
    /\ adminForce
    /\ parked > 0
    /\ onLine < Capacity
    /\ onLine' = onLine + 1
    /\ parked' = parked - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << washed, backpressure, adminForce >>

Next ==
    \/ Admit
    \/ Engage
    \/ Release
    \/ Finish
    \/ ToggleAdmin
    \/ ForceAdmit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ onLine \in 0..(Capacity + 3)
    /\ parked \in 0..TotalCars
    /\ washed \in 0..TotalCars
    /\ backpressure \in BOOLEAN
    /\ adminForce \in BOOLEAN

\* The safety property: the conveyor never holds more cars than its bays.
CapacityRespected == onLine <= Capacity

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Capacity = 3
    TotalCars = 4

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A car-wash operator runs a single conveyor line whose wash bays form a bounded work queue with backpressure. Cars wait in a source lot and are admitted onto the conveyor one at a time. The line has a fixed number of bays (its capacity). Ordinary intake only admits a waiting car when the line has raised no backpressure signal and a bay is free. The line itself raises backpressure once it is within one slot of being full, and clears that signal only after it has drained back below that threshold. A car that finishes its wash cycle leaves the line and drives off, freeing a bay. A shift supervisor holds a privileged admin override that can be toggled on or off; while the override is engaged the supervisor may force a waiting car past a raised backpressure hold, but the physical bay count is still respected so a car is never pushed on when every bay is occupied.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of cars on the conveyor line never exceeds the fixed bay capacity, under ordinary admits, backpressure engage and release, wash completions, supervisor override toggling, and privileged forced admits.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m8p0t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Pharmacists

ASSUME Pharmacists \subseteq Nat /\ Pharmacists # {}

VARIABLES
    coarse,   \* holder of the coarse cabinet-section lock (0 = free)
    fine,     \* holder of the fine drawer lock (0 = free)
    stage,    \* per pharmacist: "idle", "coarse", or "crit"
    override  \* privileged supervisor override is engaged

vars == << coarse, fine, stage, override >>

Init ==
    /\ coarse = 0
    /\ fine = 0
    /\ stage = [p \in Pharmacists |-> "idle"]
    /\ override = FALSE

\* Grab the coarse lock first (hierarchical order).
TakeCoarse(p) ==
    /\ stage[p] = "idle"
    /\ coarse = 0
    /\ coarse' = p
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, override >>

\* Only the coarse holder may then take the fine drawer lock.
TakeFine(p) ==
    /\ stage[p] = "coarse"
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine = 0
    /\ fine' = p
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "crit"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, override >>

\* Leaving the critical section drops both locks in reverse order.
Leave(p) ==
    /\ stage[p] = "crit"
    /\ fine' = 0
    /\ coarse' = 0
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << override >>

\* Supervisor toggles the privileged override.
ToggleOverride ==
    /\ override' = ~override
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, stage >>

\* Under override the supervisor forcibly evicts the current holder,
\* fully clearing both locks so the resource returns to a clean state.
ForceEvict(p) ==
    /\ override
    /\ stage[p] = "crit"
    /\ coarse' = 0
    /\ fine' = 0
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << override >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : TakeCoarse(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : TakeFine(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Leave(p)
    \/ ToggleOverride
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : ForceEvict(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Pharmacists \cup {0}
    /\ fine \in Pharmacists \cup {0}
    /\ stage \in [Pharmacists -> {"idle", "coarse", "crit"}]
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

\* Mutual exclusion: to be in the critical section a pharmacist must own
\* the single fine drawer lock, so two of them can never be inside at once.
MutexCoherent == \A p \in Pharmacists : (stage[p] = "crit") => (fine = p)

===========================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {1, 2, 3}

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT MutexCoherent
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser guards a controlled-substance cabinet as a critical resource, using hierarchical locks acquired coarse first then fine. Several pharmacists may want the cabinet. Access is staged: a pharmacist first grabs the coarse lock on the whole cabinet section, and only the current coarse holder may then grab the fine lock on the specific drawer, at which point they are inside the critical section actually dispensing. When a pharmacist leaves the critical section they drop the fine drawer lock and then the coarse section lock, in reverse order, returning both to free. A shift supervisor holds a privileged admin override that can be toggled on or off; while the override is engaged the supervisor may forcibly evict whichever pharmacist is currently in the critical section, fully clearing both the coarse and fine locks so the cabinet returns to a clean free state.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one pharmacist is ever inside the critical section dispensing, because entering it requires holding the single fine drawer lock, across coarse acquisition, fine acquisition, ordinary release, supervisor override toggling, and privileged forced eviction.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m9p3t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, MaxSlots, MaxEpoch, MinCap

ASSUME MaxSlots \in Nat /\ MaxSlots >= 2
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat
ASSUME MinCap \in Nat /\ MinCap >= 1 /\ MinCap < MaxSlots

Slots == 1..MaxSlots
NONE == 0

VARIABLES
    owner,     \* Slots -> Players \cup {NONE} : who holds each slot
    slotOf,    \* Players -> Slots \cup {NONE} : which slot each player holds
    epoch,     \* reconfiguration epoch counter
    capacity   \* number of currently active slots (1..capacity)

vars == << owner, slotOf, epoch, capacity >>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ slotOf = [p \in Players |-> NONE]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxSlots

\* Match a waiting player into a free, currently-active slot.
Allocate(p, s) ==
    /\ slotOf[p] = NONE
    /\ s <= capacity
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![p] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, capacity >>

\* A player leaves, freeing its slot.
Release(p) ==
    /\ slotOf[p] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![slotOf[p]] = NONE]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, capacity >>

\* Runtime capacity growth: activate one more slot, new epoch.
Grow ==
    /\ capacity < MaxSlots
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, slotOf >>

\* Runtime capacity shrink: deactivate the top slot, evicting its holder
\* so the mapping stays consistent, new epoch.
Shrink ==
    /\ capacity > MinCap
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ LET top == capacity
           h == owner[top]
       IN /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
          /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
          /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![top] = NONE]
          /\ slotOf' = IF h = NONE THEN slotOf
                       ELSE [slotOf EXCEPT ![h] = NONE]

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Allocate(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Release(p)
    \/ Grow
    \/ Shrink

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Players \cup {NONE}]
    /\ slotOf \in [Players -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ capacity \in MinCap..MaxSlots

\* No slot is double-allocated: the owner and slotOf maps are mutual
\* inverses, so no two players can hold the same slot at once.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE => slotOf[owner[s]] = s
    /\ \A p \in Players : slotOf[p] # NONE => owner[slotOf[p]] = p

===========================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Players = {1, 2, 3}
    MaxSlots = 3
    MaxEpoch = 4
    MinCap = 1

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker assigns numbered player slots and reconfigures its size at runtime using an epoch counter that bumps on every reconfiguration. It keeps two views that must agree: for each slot, who currently owns it, and for each player, which slot they hold. A waiting player is matched into a free slot only if that slot is currently active (its number is within the current capacity). A player may leave, freeing its slot. The lobby's capacity can change at runtime: it can grow by activating one more slot with a new epoch, or shrink by deactivating the top slot with a new epoch, in which case the holder of that now-inactive slot is evicted so the two views stay consistent.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No slot is ever double-allocated to two players at once, because the per-slot owner map and the per-player slot map are kept mutual inverses across player allocation, player release, capacity growth, and capacity shrink with eviction.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m6p3t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slots, LeaseLen, MaxTime

ASSUME LeaseLen \in Nat /\ LeaseLen >= 1
ASSUME MaxTime \in Nat /\ MaxTime >= 1

Inst == {"A", "B"}   \* two independent dispatcher instances sharing the pool
NONE == "N"

VARIABLES
    leaseHolder,  \* Slots -> Inst \cup {NONE} : who holds each slot's lease
    leaseExp,     \* Slots -> time at which the lease expires
    clock,        \* global discrete time
    alloc         \* Slots -> Inst \cup {NONE} : who is actively dispensing

vars == << leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock, alloc >>

Init ==
    /\ leaseHolder = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseExp = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]

\* Take a lease on a slot that is free or whose lease has expired, but
\* never on a slot that is currently being dispensed by anyone.
Acquire(i, s) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[s] # i
    /\ alloc[s] = NONE
    /\ (leaseHolder[s] = NONE \/ leaseExp[s] < clock)
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![s] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, alloc >>

\* Begin dispensing from a slot, but only under a still-valid lease held
\* by this same instance.
Dispense(i, s) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[s] = i
    /\ leaseExp[s] >= clock
    /\ alloc[s] = NONE
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock >>

\* Finish dispensing, freeing the slot for a fresh acquisition.
Complete(i, s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] = i
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseHolder, leaseExp, clock >>

\* Release a held lease when not actively dispensing.
Release(i, s) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[s] = i
    /\ alloc[s] = NONE
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseExp, clock, alloc >>

\* Time advances.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseHolder, leaseExp, alloc >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Inst, s \in Slots : Acquire(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, s \in Slots : Dispense(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, s \in Slots : Complete(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, s \in Slots : Release(i, s)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseHolder \in [Slots -> Inst \cup {NONE}]
    /\ leaseExp \in [Slots -> 0..(MaxTime + LeaseLen)]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Inst \cup {NONE}]

\* No slot is double-allocated: a slot being dispensed is always covered
\* by a lease held by that very instance, and leases are exclusive, so the
\* two independent instances can never both be serving the same slot.
NoDoubleAlloc == \A s \in Slots : alloc[s] # NONE => leaseHolder[s] = alloc[s]

===========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Slots = {1, 2}
    LeaseLen = 2
    MaxTime = 3

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A vending machine network lets two independent dispatcher instances, A and B, share one common pool of restock slots. Ownership of a slot is lease-based with expiry: an instance takes a lease on a slot, stamped with an expiry time computed from the current clock, and the lease only becomes available to someone else once it has expired. An instance may take a lease on a slot that is free or whose lease has already expired, but never on a slot that is currently being dispensed by anyone. To begin dispensing from a slot an instance must hold a still-valid lease on it that it owns itself. When dispensing completes the slot is freed for a fresh acquisition, and an instance may also release a held lease when it is not actively dispensing. A global clock advances over time, which is what causes leases to expire.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No slot is ever double-allocated to both instances at once, because any slot being dispensed is always covered by a lease held by that same instance and leases are exclusive, maintained across lease acquisition, dispensing, completion, lease release, and clock ticks.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m8p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxUpdates

ASSUME Controllers \subseteq Nat /\ Controllers # {}
ASSUME MaxUpdates \in Nat /\ MaxUpdates >= 1

NONE == 0

VARIABLES
    record,    \* the shared signalling record's value
    version,   \* version counter, bumped on each committed update
    coarse,    \* holder of the coarse interlocking lock (0 = free)
    fine,      \* holder of the fine block lock (0 = free)
    readVer,   \* Controllers -> version snapshotted when entering write section
    crashed    \* set of controllers that have silently crashed

vars == << record, version, coarse, fine, readVer, crashed >>

Init ==
    /\ record = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ readVer = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Acquire the coarse interlocking lock first.
TakeCoarse(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, version, fine, readVer, crashed >>

\* Then the fine block lock; snapshot the current version on entry.
TakeFine(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = c
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ fine' = c
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, version, coarse, crashed >>

\* Commit an update only if the snapshot still matches: no intervening
\* update was lost. Releases both locks.
Commit(c) ==
    /\ fine = c
    /\ readVer[c] = version
    /\ version < MaxUpdates
    /\ record' = record + 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ fine' = NONE
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << readVer, crashed >>

\* Abandon the write section without writing, releasing both locks.
Abort(c) ==
    /\ fine = c
    /\ fine' = NONE
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, version, readVer, crashed >>

\* Release the coarse lock when the fine lock was never taken.
ReleaseCoarse(c) ==
    /\ coarse = c
    /\ fine # c
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, version, fine, readVer, crashed >>

\* At most one controller ever crashes silently, dropping any locks it held.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {c}
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = c THEN NONE ELSE coarse
    /\ fine' = IF fine = c THEN NONE ELSE fine
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, version, readVer >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : TakeCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : TakeFine(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Abort(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : ReleaseCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \in 0..MaxUpdates
    /\ version \in 0..MaxUpdates
    /\ coarse \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ readVer \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxUpdates]
    /\ crashed \in SUBSET Controllers

\* No lost updates: whoever holds the fine block lock still has a snapshot
\* equal to the live version, so any commit they make is based on the most
\* recent state and cannot silently overwrite an intervening update.
NoLostUpdate == \A c \in Controllers : (fine = c) => (readVer[c] = version)

===========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {1, 2}
    MaxUpdates = 3

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A subway signalling block system has controllers that update a single shared signalling record, protected by hierarchical locks acquired coarse first then fine. A controller must first take the coarse interlocking lock, then take the fine block lock; at the moment it takes the fine lock it snapshots the record's current version number. It may commit an update only if that snapshot still matches the live version, meaning no other update slipped in between; committing bumps the version and the record and releases both locks. A controller may instead abort the write section without writing, releasing both locks, and a controller that took only the coarse lock may release it. One participant can crash silently at some point, dropping whatever locks it was holding so the surviving controller can proceed; at most one participant ever crashes.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No update to the shared record is ever lost, because whoever holds the fine block lock still holds a version snapshot equal to the live version, so any commit is based on the most recent state, across coarse acquisition, fine acquisition with snapshot, commit, abort, coarse release, and a single silent crash.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m3p3t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Robots, Slots, MaxTerm

ASSUME Robots \subseteq Nat /\ Robots # {}
ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 1

NONE == 0

VARIABLES
    leader,     \* current fleet leader (0 = no leader)
    term,       \* election term / epoch
    assignment, \* Slots -> Robots \cup {NONE} : leader's slot ledger
    robotSlot,  \* Robots -> Slots \cup {NONE} : slot each robot believes it holds
    override    \* privileged operator override engaged

vars == << leader, term, assignment, robotSlot, override >>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ assignment = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ robotSlot = [r \in Robots |-> NONE]
    /\ override = FALSE

\* Elect a leader when there is none.
Elect(r) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assignment, robotSlot, override >>

\* Failover: a different robot takes over from a live leader.
Failover(r) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader # r
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assignment, robotSlot, override >>

\* The leader grants a free slot to a robot that holds none.
Grant(r, s) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ robotSlot[r] = NONE
    /\ assignment[s] = NONE
    /\ assignment' = [assignment EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ robotSlot' = [robotSlot EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, override >>

\* A robot returns its slot.
Return(r) ==
    /\ robotSlot[r] # NONE
    /\ assignment' = [assignment EXCEPT ![robotSlot[r]] = NONE]
    /\ robotSlot' = [robotSlot EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, override >>

\* Under override, the operator forcibly reclaims a slot and clears its
\* holder's belief, keeping ledger and beliefs consistent.
AdminReclaim(r) ==
    /\ override
    /\ robotSlot[r] # NONE
    /\ assignment' = [assignment EXCEPT ![robotSlot[r]] = NONE]
    /\ robotSlot' = [robotSlot EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, override >>

\* Toggle the privileged override (always available).
ToggleOverride ==
    /\ override' = ~override
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, assignment, robotSlot >>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Elect(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Failover(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, s \in Slots : Grant(r, s)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Return(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : AdminReclaim(r)
    \/ ToggleOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Robots \cup {NONE}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ assignment \in [Slots -> Robots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ robotSlot \in [Robots -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

\* No double allocation: whenever a robot believes it holds a slot, the
\* leader's ledger records that slot as belonging to that same robot, and
\* the ledger is single-valued, so no slot is ever handed to two robots.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A r \in Robots : robotSlot[r] # NONE => assignment[robotSlot[r]] = r

===========================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Robots = {1, 2}
    Slots = {1, 2}
    MaxTerm = 3

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet assigns numbered storage slots to robots through an elected leader, with failover. When there is no leader one is elected, incrementing the election term; a different robot may take over from a live leader through failover, again incrementing the term. The leader grants a free slot to a robot that currently holds none, recording the assignment in its ledger and updating that robot's belief about which slot it holds. A robot may return its slot, clearing both the ledger entry and its belief. A privileged operator override can be toggled on or off at any time; while it is engaged the operator may forcibly reclaim a robot's slot, clearing the ledger entry and that robot's belief together so the two stay consistent.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No storage slot is ever double-allocated to two robots, because whenever a robot believes it holds a slot the leader's single-valued ledger records that slot as belonging to that same robot, maintained across leader election, failover, granting, returning, privileged reclamation, and override toggling.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m9p5t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch >= 1

VARIABLES
    phase,    \* "arming" or "committed" : state of the one-time settlement
    staged,   \* the irreversible payout has been prepared
    commits,  \* how many times the irreversible settlement has fired
    epoch,    \* reconfiguration epoch counter
    override  \* privileged admin override engaged

vars == << phase, staged, commits, epoch, override >>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "arming"
    /\ staged = FALSE
    /\ commits = 0
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ override = FALSE

\* Prepare the one-time payout while still arming.
Prepare ==
    /\ phase = "arming"
    /\ ~staged
    /\ staged' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, commits, epoch, override >>

\* Fire the irreversible settlement exactly once, from armed+staged.
Fire ==
    /\ phase = "arming"
    /\ staged
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ commits' = commits + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << staged, epoch, override >>

\* Reconfigure the network (new epoch) without disturbing the settlement.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, staged, commits, override >>

\* Under override the admin may cancel a prepared-but-unfired payout.
AdminUnstage ==
    /\ override
    /\ phase = "arming"
    /\ staged
    /\ staged' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, commits, epoch, override >>

\* Toggle the privileged override (always available).
ToggleOverride ==
    /\ override' = ~override
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, staged, commits, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ Prepare
    \/ Fire
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ AdminUnstage
    \/ ToggleOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"arming", "committed"}
    /\ staged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ commits \in 0..2
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

\* The irreversible settlement happens at most once: the commit counter is
\* exactly one once committed and zero while still arming, so no
\* reconfiguration or override can cause a second irreversible firing.
CommitOnce == commits = (IF phase = "committed" THEN 1 ELSE 0)

===========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    MaxEpoch = 3

INIT Init
NEXT Next

INVARIANT CommitOnce
nl:
A vending machine network performs a one-time irreversible settlement per transaction and reconfigures itself at runtime using an epoch counter. The settlement starts in an arming phase. While still arming, the network may prepare (stage) the one-time payout. From the armed-and-staged state it may fire the irreversible settlement, moving to the committed phase and incrementing a commit counter. The network can reconfigure at any time, bumping its epoch, without disturbing the settlement state. A privileged admin override can be toggled on or off at any time; while it is engaged the admin may cancel a prepared-but-unfired payout, un-staging it, but the admin can never undo a settlement that has already fired.

    /\ holder' = IF holder = o THEN NONE ELSE holder

    /\ o \in authorized
    /\ reqRound[o] = round
    /\ holder' = o

    /\ opCount < MaxOps

    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << authorized, round, reqRound >>

    \/ \E o \in Operators : Refresh(o)

    shedding,  \* TRUE while a load-shed action is in force

    /\ o \notin voted

    /\ Cardinality(voted) >= Quorum
    /\ shedding' = TRUE
    /\ shedVotes' = Cardinality(voted)
    /\ UNCHANGED << round, voted >>

    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ voted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << shedding, shedVotes >>

    /\ shedding' = FALSE
    /\ shedVotes' = 0
    /\ voted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << round >>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Operators : Vote(o)
    \/ Shed
    \/ NewRound
    \/ Restore

    /\ round \in 1..MaxRound
    /\ voted \in SUBSET Operators
    /\ shedding \in BOOLEAN
    /\ shedVotes \in 0..Cardinality(Operators)

    /\ term = 0
    /\ printing = NONE

    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << printing, jobCount, knownTerm >>

    /\ leader # n
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ printing' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << jobCount, knownTerm >>

    /\ knownTerm[n] # term
    /\ knownTerm' = [knownTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, printing, jobCount >>

    /\ leader = n
    /\ knownTerm[n] = term
    /\ printing' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, jobCount, knownTerm >>

    /\ leader = n
    /\ jobCount < MaxJobs

    /\ printing' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, knownTerm >>

    /\ printing' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, jobCount, knownTerm >>

    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Failover(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Sync(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Grab(n)

    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ printing \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ jobCount \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ knownTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxTerm]

\* printer is the current leader, so a deposed former leader (stale after a
\* failover) or any non-leader node can never drive the printer.
NoStaleAction == printing # NONE => printing = leader

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m8p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxBays

ASSUME Cranes \subseteq Nat /\ Cranes # {}
ASSUME MaxBays \in Nat /\ MaxBays >= 1

NONE == 0

VARIABLES
    regionLock,  \* holder of the coarse yard-region lock (0 = free)
    bayLock,     \* holder of the fine bay lock (0 = free)
    stage,       \* Cranes -> "idle", "region", or "lifting"
    capacity     \* number of bays currently commissioned (changes at runtime)

vars == << regionLock, bayLock, stage, capacity >>

Init ==
    /\ regionLock = NONE
    /\ bayLock = NONE
    /\ stage = [c \in Cranes |-> "idle"]
    /\ capacity = MaxBays

\* Acquire the coarse region lock first (hierarchical order).
TakeRegion(c) ==
    /\ stage[c] = "idle"
    /\ regionLock = NONE
    /\ regionLock' = c
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![c] = "region"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << bayLock, capacity >>

\* Only the region holder may take the fine bay lock, and only if a bay is
\* commissioned; taking it records the bay-lock owner as it starts lifting.
TakeBay(c) ==
    /\ stage[c] = "region"
    /\ regionLock = c
    /\ bayLock = NONE
    /\ capacity > 0
    /\ bayLock' = c
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![c] = "lifting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, capacity >>

\* Finish lifting, releasing both locks in reverse order.
Release(c) ==
    /\ stage[c] = "lifting"
    /\ bayLock' = NONE
    /\ regionLock' = NONE
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << capacity >>

\* Give up the region lock without ever lifting.
DropRegion(c) ==
    /\ stage[c] = "region"
    /\ regionLock' = NONE
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << bayLock, capacity >>

\* Commission another bay at runtime.
Commission ==
    /\ capacity < MaxBays
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, bayLock, stage >>

\* Decommission a bay at runtime.
Decommission ==
    /\ capacity > 0
    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, bayLock, stage >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : TakeRegion(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : TakeBay(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : DropRegion(c)
    \/ Commission
    \/ Decommission

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ regionLock \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ bayLock \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ stage \in [Cranes -> {"idle", "region", "lifting"}]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxBays

\* Mutual exclusion: a crane is lifting only while it owns the single fine
\* bay lock, so no two cranes ever lift over the shared bay at once.
MutualExclusion == \A c \in Cranes : (stage[c] = "lifting") => (bayLock = c)

    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN NONE ELSE leader

    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, record, staged, crashed >>

    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Failover(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Propose(n)

ASSUME MaxLanes \in Nat /\ MaxLanes >= 1

    rowLock,     \* holder of the fine account-row lock (0 = free)
    version,     \* version counter of the shared account record
    readVer,     \* Tellers -> version snapshotted on entering the write section
    lanes        \* number of settlement lanes open (changes at runtime)

    /\ lanes = MaxLanes

TakeLedger(t) ==
    /\ ledgerLock = NONE
    /\ ledgerLock' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED << rowLock, version, readVer, lanes >>

TakeRow(t) ==
    /\ ledgerLock = t
    /\ rowLock = NONE
    /\ rowLock' = t
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![t] = version]

\* no intervening update was lost; releases both locks.

    /\ ledgerLock' = NONE

    /\ ledgerLock' = NONE

    /\ UNCHANGED << ledgerLock, rowLock, version, readVer >>

    \/ \E t \in Tellers : TakeRow(t)

    \/ \E t \in Tellers : Abort(t)

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m2p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Participants, Instances, MaxVal

ASSUME Participants \subseteq Nat /\ Participants # {}
ASSUME Instances \subseteq Nat /\ Instances # {}
ASSUME MaxVal \in Nat /\ MaxVal >= 1

NONE == 0

VARIABLES
    phase,   \* "idle","prepared","committed","aborted" : txn phase
    holder,  \* which of the two instances owns the current txn (0 = none)
    votes,   \* Participants -> "n" or "y"
    record,  \* the shared settlement record's value
    staged   \* the value the current txn will write on commit

vars == << phase, holder, votes, record, staged >>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ votes = [p \in Participants |-> "n"]
    /\ record = 0
    /\ staged = 0

\* One of the two independent instances opens a transaction on the shared
\* record, proposing a value to write.
Begin(i, v) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ v \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ phase' = "prepared"
    /\ holder' = i
    /\ staged' = v
    /\ votes' = [p \in Participants |-> "n"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << record >>

\* A participant casts its yes vote in the prepare phase.
Vote(p) ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ votes[p] = "n"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = "y"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, holder, record, staged >>

\* Commit only after unanimous yes: apply the staged value to the record.
CommitTxn ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ \A p \in Participants : votes[p] = "y"
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ record' = staged
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, votes, staged >>

\* Abort while still preparing when some participant has not voted.
AbortTxn ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ \E p \in Participants : votes[p] = "n"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, votes, record, staged >>

\* Release the shared record back to idle for the next instance.
Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, record, staged >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, v \in 0..MaxVal : Begin(i, v)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Vote(p)
    \/ CommitTxn
    \/ AbortTxn
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "prepared", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ holder \in Instances \cup {NONE}
    /\ votes \in [Participants -> {"n", "y"}]
    /\ record \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ staged \in 0..MaxVal

\* No lost updates: whenever a transaction reaches the committed state its
\* staged value is fully present in the shared settlement record, so a
\* committed update is never silently dropped even as the two instances
\* take turns on the shared record.
NoLostUpdate == (phase = "committed") => (record = staged)

SAFETY PROPERTY: No update to the shared settlement record is ever lost, meaning whenever a transaction reaches the committed state its staged value is fully present in the shared record, so a committed update is never silently dropped even as the two instances take turns on the shared record, across transaction begin, voting, commit on unanimous yes, abort, and reset.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m6p4t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Capacity, LeaseLen, MaxTime

ASSUME Capacity \in Nat /\ Capacity >= 1
ASSUME LeaseLen \in Nat /\ LeaseLen >= 1
ASSUME MaxTime \in Nat /\ MaxTime >= 1

VARIABLES
    aHold,   \* settlement slots leased by instance A
    bHold,   \* settlement slots leased by instance B
    clock,   \* discrete time
    expiry   \* time at which the currently outstanding leases lapse

vars == << aHold, bHold, clock, expiry >>

Init ==
    /\ aHold = 0
    /\ bHold = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ expiry = 0

Cap(x) == IF x > MaxTime THEN MaxTime ELSE x

\* Instance A leases a slot, but only while the shared pool is below its
\* bounded capacity; refreshes the lease window.
AcquireA ==
    /\ aHold + bHold < Capacity
    /\ aHold' = aHold + 1
    /\ expiry' = Cap(clock + LeaseLen)
    /\ UNCHANGED << bHold, clock >>

\* Instance B leases a slot under the same capacity bound.
AcquireB ==
    /\ aHold + bHold < Capacity
    /\ bHold' = bHold + 1
    /\ expiry' = Cap(clock + LeaseLen)
    /\ UNCHANGED << aHold, clock >>

\* Instance A's lease lapses once the lease window has passed.
ExpireA ==
    /\ aHold > 0
    /\ clock >= expiry
    /\ aHold' = aHold - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << bHold, clock, expiry >>

\* Instance B's lease lapses once the lease window has passed.
ExpireB ==
    /\ bHold > 0
    /\ clock >= expiry
    /\ bHold' = bHold - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << aHold, clock, expiry >>

\* Time advances.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << aHold, bHold, expiry >>

Next ==
    \/ AcquireA
    \/ AcquireB
    \/ ExpireA
    \/ ExpireB
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ aHold \in 0..(Capacity + 2)
    /\ bHold \in 0..(Capacity + 2)
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ expiry \in 0..MaxTime

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the total number of settlement slots
\* leased across the two independent instances sharing the pool never rises
\* above the fixed capacity.
CapacityRespected == aHold + bHold <= Capacity

===========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Capacity = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
    MaxTime = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch manages a bounded pool of settlement slots leased by two independent instances, A and B, using lease-based ownership with expiry. Each instance may lease a slot, but only while the total number of leased slots across both instances is below the pool's fixed bounded capacity; acquiring refreshes the lease window relative to the current clock. An instance's leases lapse once the lease window has passed. Time advances on a discrete clock, which is what causes lease windows to elapse.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The bounded capacity of the shared settlement pool is never exceeded, meaning the total number of slots leased across the two independent instances sharing the pool never rises above the fixed capacity, maintained across lease acquisition by either instance, lease expiry, and clock ticks.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m6p5t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

VARIABLES
    phase,         \* "armed" or "released" : state of the one-time drop
    releaseCount,  \* how many times the irreversible retardant drop happened
    leased,        \* TRUE while the drone holds a valid drop lease
    override       \* privileged incident-commander override engaged

vars == << phase, releaseCount, leased, override >>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "armed"
    /\ releaseCount = 0
    /\ leased = FALSE
    /\ override = FALSE

\* The drone acquires a drop lease while still armed.
Acquire ==
    /\ phase = "armed"
    /\ ~leased
    /\ leased' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, releaseCount, override >>

\* Perform the single irreversible retardant drop; requires a held lease.
Release ==
    /\ phase = "armed"
    /\ leased
    /\ phase' = "released"
    /\ releaseCount' = releaseCount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leased, override >>

\* The drop lease expires on its own.
Expire ==
    /\ leased
    /\ leased' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, releaseCount, override >>

\* Under override, the commander may revoke a lease before any drop happens.
AdminRevoke ==
    /\ override
    /\ leased
    /\ leased' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, releaseCount, override >>

\* Toggle the privileged override (always available).
ToggleOverride ==
    /\ override' = ~override
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, releaseCount, leased >>

Next ==
    \/ Acquire
    \/ Release
    \/ Expire
    \/ AdminRevoke
    \/ ToggleOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"armed", "released"}
    /\ releaseCount \in 0..2
    /\ leased \in BOOLEAN
    /\ override \in BOOLEAN

\* The irreversible retardant drop happens at most once: the release counter
\* is exactly one once released and zero while still armed, so no lease churn
\* or override can ever cause a second drop.
DropOnce == releaseCount = (IF phase = "released" THEN 1 ELSE 0)

===========================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DropOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm performs a single irreversible retardant drop per mission, governed by lease-based ownership of the drop authority. The drop starts armed. While armed, the drone may acquire a drop lease. From the armed-and-leased state it may perform the single irreversible retardant drop, moving to the released state and incrementing a release counter. The drop lease may expire on its own at any time. A privileged incident-commander override can be toggled on or off at any time; while it is engaged the commander may revoke a lease before any drop happens, but the commander can never undo a drop that has already been released.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible retardant drop happens at most once, meaning the release counter is exactly one once released and zero while still armed, so no lease acquisition, expiry, revocation, or override can ever cause a second drop.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m9p3t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slots, Instances, MaxEpoch

ASSUME Slots \subseteq Nat /\ Slots # {}
ASSUME Instances \subseteq Nat /\ Instances # {}
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch >= 1

NONE == 0

VARIABLES
    owner,   \* Slots -> Instances \cup {NONE} : which instance reserves each slot
    claim,   \* Instances -> Slots \cup {NONE} : the slot each instance reserves
    epoch,   \* reconfiguration epoch counter
    active   \* the subset of shelves (slots) currently open for reservation

vars == << owner, claim, epoch, active >>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claim = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ active = Slots

\* An instance reserves a free, currently-open slot, recording both
\* directions of the mapping together.
Reserve(i, s) ==
    /\ claim[i] = NONE
    /\ s \in active
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![i] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, active >>

\* An instance releases its reservation, clearing both directions.
Release(i) ==
    /\ claim[i] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![claim[i]] = NONE]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, active >>

\* Retune which shelves are open (a non-empty set), without disturbing the
\* existing reservation mapping.
Retune(newActive) ==
    /\ newActive \subseteq Slots
    /\ newActive # {}
    /\ active' = newActive
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, claim, epoch >>

\* Epoch-numbered reconfiguration: bump the epoch and clear every
\* reservation so the shared pool is reallocated from a clean slate.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ owner' = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claim' = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << active >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Slots : Reserve(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)
    \/ \E na \in SUBSET Slots : Retune(na)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Instances \cup {NONE}]
    /\ claim \in [Instances -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ active \in SUBSET Slots

\* No double allocation: the per-slot owner map and the per-instance claim
\* map are mutual inverses, so no slot is ever reserved by two instances at
\* once and the two independent instances never collide on the shared pool.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE => claim[owner[s]] = s
    /\ \A i \in Instances : claim[i] # NONE => owner[claim[i]] = i

===========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Slots = {1, 2}
    Instances = {1, 2}
    MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A library book reservation system allocates numbered reservation slots from one shared pool used by two independent reservation instances, and reconfigures the pool at runtime using an epoch counter. It keeps two views that must agree: for each slot, which instance reserves it, and for each instance, which slot it reserves. An instance reserves a free slot only if it currently holds no reservation, recording both directions of the mapping together. An instance may release its reservation, clearing both directions. An epoch-numbered reconfiguration bumps the epoch and clears every reservation so the shared pool is reallocated from a clean, consistent slate.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No reservation slot is ever double-allocated to two instances at once, because the per-slot owner map and the per-instance claim map are kept mutual inverses, so the two independent instances never collide on the shared pool, across reservation, release, and epoch-numbered reconfiguration.
